sample_unit: responses per group (36 questions, ChatGPT queried twice daily for 15 days)

links.outcome: Repeatability of ChatGPT answers across repeated daily runs (ICC, SEM, CV)
links.effect: Fair reliability: ICC = 0.427, SEM 25.18, CV 61.7%, indicating moderate variability across repeated responses.
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated fair reliability (ICC = 0.427), with SEM of 25.18 and CV of 61.7% indicating moderate variability.

links.outcome: ChatGPT accuracy compared with prosthodontists on prosthodontics questions
links.effect: Prosthodontists outperformed ChatGPT in overall accuracy (p < 0.05), notably on medium-difficulty and clinical questions; ChatGPT lacked consistency and clinical judgment.
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrates moderate ability in delivering accurate theoretical information but lacks consistency and clinical judgment.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, repeatability, and reasoning quality of ChatGPT-4o mini on 36 prosthodontics questions compared with expert prosthodontists; does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
